releaseNotes:
• Liquid Glass Skill Architecture (deepika-builds/liquid-glass): Adopted proven optical displacement recipe with perimeter refraction bulge, neutral interior inset, and 1.5x saturation boost
• Chromatic Prism Fringe: Staggered three-channel chromatic aberration (chroma: 6 / dispersion: 0.032) delivering Apple-grade refraction rim
• Optical Material Dressing: Translucent gradient tint (rgba(14, 14, 22, 0.18-0.32) in dark, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32-0.18) in light) with specular hairline top highlight and deep elevation drop shadow
• 100% Preserved Button Style: Feed active capsule, Stats, Playlists, and circular Search satellite intact
• Permanent Background & Lock-Screen Playback: Continuous foreground lifecycle, dedicated WakeLock, WifiLock, and pre-warmed streams
